اختلسن (form VIII)
# اِخْتَلَسْنَ (iḵtalasna) /ix.ta.las.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
# اُخْتُلِسْنَ (uḵtulisna) /ux.tu.lis.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
# اِخْتَلِسْنَ (iḵtalisna) /ix.ta.lis.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
